info.name: Sociva Unified Inbox API
info.description: Postman collection for testing Sociva's Unified Social Media Inbox architecture: Webhooks, Backend Filter, Message Queue, AI Agent, and Replies.

request.description: Tests the verification challenge handshake that Meta (Instagram/Facebook) requires when you configure a webhook URL in Meta App Dashboard.
Simulates Meta sending a real Instagram Messaging webhook event. Server immediately responds with EVENT_RECEIVED (200 OK), filters the event, queues to BullMQ, and invokes AI Agent.

item.name: 3. Simulator: Customer Message (Passes Filter -> Queues to AI)

request.description: Passes through Backend Filtering, gets enqueued to BullMQ AI queue, generates sentiment & intent score, and pushes live update to Socket.IO dashboard.
Demonstrates Optimization #1 & #2: Backend filter discards brand echo messages before reaching AI or Socket.IO, preventing infinite reply loops.
Demonstrates spam filtering: Irrelevant spam is dropped immediately, saving LLM token cost.
Retrieves conversations sorted by most recent message, with support for folder, platform, and search filters.
Replace {{CONVERSATION_ID}} with an _id from the Get Conversations list to retrieve the full chat history.
Sends reply via official Instagram Messaging API and persists in MongoDB, broadcasting live update via Socket.IO.
Returns counts for auto-replied messages, avg response time, sales leads, and open issues.
Toggles whether the AI agent automatically replies to qualifying incoming messages or leaves them as suggested drafts.
